en.t: The death of Bardas Phokas the Younger in the battle of Abydos ends his second rebellion against Byzantine Emperor Basil II
en.s: Bardas Phokas (or Phocas) (Greek: Βάρδας Φωκᾶς) (c. 940–13 April 989) was a Byzantine general who took a conspicuous part in three revolts for and against the ruling Macedonian dynasty.

zh.t: 拜占庭将领巴尔达斯·福卡斯去世
zh.s: 989年4月13日，反抗皇帝巴西尔二世的拜占庭将领巴尔达斯·福卡斯在阿卑多斯附近两军对阵时突然发病坠马身亡，叛乱随之失败。他约生于940年，在围绕马其顿王朝统治的三次叛乱中都扮演过重要角色，有时为王朝作战，有时反对王朝。

en.t: Battle of the Horns of Hama
en.s: The Battle of the Horns of Hama or Hammah (Arabic: معركة قرون حماة, Qurun Hama;(Kurdish: شەڕی قۆچەکانی حەمە, şerê qijikên hamayê) 13 April AD 1175; 19 Ramadan ah 570) was an Ayyubid victory over the Zengids, which left Saladin in control of Damascus, Baalbek, and Homs. en.t: Battle of Frankfurt an der Oder
en.s: The Battle of Frankfurt an der Oder on 13 April 1631 took place during the Thirty Years' War. The Imperial city of Frankfurt an der Oder was taken by a Swedish army, the first town within the Empire to be occupied outside Pomerania, where Sweden had established a bridgehead in 1630. After a two-day siege, Swedish forces, including several regiments of Scottish auxiliaries, stormed the town.

zh.t: 奥得河畔法兰克福之战
zh.s: 奥得河畔法兰克福之战发生于三十年战争期间的1631年4月13日。瑞典军队攻占了帝国城市奥得河畔法兰克福，这是瑞典在1630年于波美拉尼亚建立桥头堡后，首次占领帝国境内波美拉尼亚以外的城镇。包括数个苏格兰辅助团在内的瑞典军队，围城两天后发动强攻，夺下该城。

en.s: The Battle of Ripple Field, fought on 13 April 1643, was an important engagement in the English Civil War. It was a Royalist victory, with the routing of a combined cavalry and infantry Parliamentarian force by a predominantly cavalry force led by Prince Maurice of the Palatinate. After marching north from Tewkesbury, Sir William Waller tried to contain the cavalry forces of Maurice on the western bank of the Severn, cutting this substantial force off from the rest of the Royalist army. Maurice successfully crossed the Severn at Upton-Upon-Severn, and quickly proceeded south through Ryall to meet with Waller's men who had taken a defensive position in Ripple Field.

zh.s: 里普尔原野之战于1643年4月13日发生，是英国内战中的一次重要交战。普法尔茨的莫里茨亲王率领一支以骑兵为主的保王党军队，击溃由骑兵与步兵组成的议会派部队，取得胜利。威廉·沃勒爵士从蒂克斯伯里向北进军后，试图将莫里茨的骑兵限制在塞文河西岸，使这支规模可观的部队与保王党其余军队隔绝。但莫里茨成功在塞文河畔厄普顿渡河，迅速经赖奥尔南下，迎战已在里普尔原野建立防御阵地的沃勒部队。

en.s: The Austro-Turkish War (1716–1718) was fought between the Habsburg monarchy and the Ottoman Empire. The 1699 Treaty of Karlowitz was not an acceptable permanent agreement for the Ottoman Empire. Twelve years after Karlowitz, it began the long-term prospect of taking revenge for its defeat at the Battle of Vienna in 1683. First, the army of Turkish Grand Vizier Baltacı Mehmet defeated Peter the Great's Russian Army in the Russo-Turkish War (1710–1713).

en.t: George Frideric Handel's oratorio Messiah makes its world premiere in Dublin, Ireland
en.s: George Frideric (or Frederick) Handel ( HAN-dəl; baptised Georg Fried[e]rich Händel, German: [ˈɡeːɔʁk ˈfʁiːdʁɪç ˈhɛndl̩] ; 5 March 1685 [O.S. 23 February 1684] – 14 April 1759) was a German-British Baroque composer well-known for his operas, oratorios, anthems, concerti grossi, and organ concerti. Born in Halle, Handel spent his early life in Hamburg and Italy before settling in London in 1712, where he spent the bulk of his career and became a naturalised British subject in 1727.

zh.t: 亨德尔清唱剧《弥赛亚》首演
zh.s: 1742年4月13日，亨德尔的清唱剧《弥赛亚》在爱尔兰都柏林首演。乔治·弗里德里克·亨德尔生于1685年、逝于1759年，是德裔英国巴洛克作曲家，以歌剧、清唱剧、赞美诗、合奏协奏曲及管风琴协奏曲闻名。他出生于哈雷，早年曾在汉堡和意大利生活，1712年定居伦敦，1727年归化英国。

en.s: The Battle of Bound Brook (April 13, 1777) was a surprise attack conducted by British and Hessian forces against a Continental Army outpost at Bound Brook, New Jersey during the American Revolutionary War. The British objective of capturing the entire garrison was not met, although prisoners were taken. The American commander, Major General Benjamin Lincoln, left in great haste, abandoning papers and personal effects. Late on the evening of April 12, 1777, four thousand British and Hessian troops under the command of Lieutenant General Charles Cornwallis marched from the British stronghold of New Brunswick.

zh.s: 1777年4月13日，美国独立战争期间，英国与黑森军队突袭了新泽西州邦德布鲁克的大陆军前哨。英方虽俘获部分守军，却未能实现俘获全部驻军的目标。美军指挥官本杰明·林肯少将仓促撤离，留下文件和私人物品。前一天深夜，查尔斯·康沃利斯中将已率领4000名英国及黑森军人，从英军据点新不伦瑞克出发。

en.s: In the Battle of Castalla on 13 April 1813, an Anglo-Spanish-Sicilian force commanded by Lieutenant General Sir John Murray fought Marshal Louis Gabriel Suchet's French Army of Valencia and Aragon. Murray's troops successfully repelled a series of French attacks on their hilltop position, causing Suchet to retreat. The action took place during the Peninsular War, part of the Napoleonic Wars. Castalla is located 35 kilometers north-northwest of Alicante, Spain. General Arthur Wellesley, Marquess of Wellington wanted to prevent Suchet from reinforcing the other French armies in Spain. He ordered, Murray, whose army had been built up to over 18,000 Allied troops, to accomplish this purpose.

en.s: The Jallianwala Bagh massacre, also known as the Amritsar massacre, took place on 13 April 1919 when a crowd of nonviolent protesters, along with Baishakhi pilgrims, who had gathered in Jallianwala Bagh, Amritsar, Punjab, were fired upon by troops of the British Indian Army under the command of Colonel Reginald Dyer. The civilians had assembled to participate in the annual Baisakhi celebrations—both a religious and cultural festival for the Punjabis. Coming from outside the city, they may have been unaware of the martial law that had been imposed. The Bagh-space comprised 6 to 7 acres (28,000 m2) and was walled on all sides with five entrances.

en.s: The Glasgow Garscadden by-election, 1978 was a parliamentary by-election held on 13 April 1978 for the British House of Commons constituency of Glasgow Garscadden, in the north west periphery of the City of Glasgow. It was won by Donald Dewar of the Labour Party. It was important in that it was widely seen as halting the Scottish National Party (SNP) tide in the 1970s.

en.s: Hainan is an island and the southernmost province of China, consisting of the eponymous Hainan Island and various smaller islands in the South China Sea under the province's administration. en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in South Korea on 13 April 2000. en.s: (For other battles that occurred in N'Djamena, see Battle of N'Djamena (disambiguation).) The Battle of N'Djamena was a battle between the forces of the revolutionary United Front for Democratic Change (UFCD) and the military of Chad that occurred on 13 April 2006 when rebel forces launched an assault on the capital of Chad in the pre-dawn hours, attempting to overthrow the government of President Idriss Déby Itno from their bases an estimated thousand miles east. The battle occurred just months after serious Chad-Sudan tensions ended with the signing of the Tripoli Agreement.

zh.s: 2006年4月13日凌晨，争取民主变革联合阵线的叛军从估计位于以东约1000英里处的基地出发，进攻乍得首都，企图推翻伊德里斯·代比·伊特诺总统政府，与乍得军队展开恩贾梅纳之战。此前几个月，乍得与苏丹之间的严重紧张局势刚因《的黎波里协议》的签署而缓解。同地发生的其他战役，另见“恩贾梅纳之战”相关条目。

en.t: The United Front for Democratic Change's attack on the Chadian capital of N'Djamena is repelled by the Chadian army

en.s: re:publica is a conference in Europe that deals with Web 2.0, especially blogs, social media, and information society. It annually takes place in May in Berlin. en.s: Lombardy renewed its delegation to the Italian Senate on April 13, 2008. This election was a part of national Italian general election of 2008 even if, according to the Italian Constitution, every senatorial challenge in each Region is a single and independent race. The election was won by the centre-right coalition between The People of Freedom and Lega Nord, as it happened at the national level. The People of Freedom was the largest party in the election with 34%, ahead of the Democratic Party (28%) and Lega Nord (21%). All provinces gave a majority or a plurality to the new Italian Prime Minister.

en.s: Lockdown (2008) was a professional wrestling pay-per-view (PPV) event produced by the Total Nonstop Action Wrestling (TNA) promotion, which took place on April 13, 2008 at the Tsongas Arena in |Boston, Massachusetts. It was the fourth under the Lockdown chronology and fourth event in the 2008 TNA PPV schedule. Eight professional wrestling matches, two of which for championships, were featured on the card. In the tradition of Lockdown events, every match took place inside a six sided steel structure known as the Six Sides of Steel.

en.s: The Kamień Pomorski homeless hostel fire occurred in north-western Poland at 00:30 local time (23:30 UTC) on 13 April 2009. The fire occurred during the night at a three-story homeless hostel in Kamień Pomorski (West Pomeranian Voivodeship), a town with a population of 10,000 situated approximately 60 kilometres or 37 miles from the German border. 23 people, including 13 children were pronounced dead, with a further 20 sustaining an injury of some sort. The hostel was completely destroyed and the corpses of many people were charred beyond recognition in a fire that the BBC called "one of the deadliest in living memory".

zh.t: 卡缅波莫尔斯基无家可归者旅舍火灾
zh.s: 2009年4月13日当地时间凌晨0时30分（协调世界时前一日23时30分），波兰西北部西滨海省卡缅波莫尔斯基一座三层无家可归者旅舍发生火灾。该镇人口约1万，距德国边境约60公里（37英里）。火灾造成23人死亡，其中13人为儿童，另有20人不同程度受伤。旅舍被完全烧毁，许多遇难者遗体烧焦，难以辨认。英国广播公司称其为“人们记忆中死亡人数最多的火灾之一”。

en.s: The 2010 special election for Florida's 19th congressional district took place on April 13, 2010, to fill the vacancy caused by Representative Robert Wexler's resignation, effective the evening of January 3, 2010, from the United States House of Representatives. Wexler, who had represented the 19th district since 1997, left Congress to become president of the Center for Middle East Peace & Economic Cooperation. Governor Charlie Crist on November 4, 2009 set the primary for February 2 and the general election for April 13, 2010 (rescheduled from April 6 to avoid Passover). Democrat Ted Deutch won the Special Election with 62%, with Republican Edward Lynch received 35%.

zh.t: 2010年佛罗里达州第十九国会选区特别选举
zh.s: 佛罗里达州第十九国会选区于2010年4月13日举行特别选举，填补联邦众议员罗伯特·韦克斯勒辞职留下的空缺。他的辞职于2010年1月3日晚生效。韦克斯勒自1997年起代表该选区，离开国会后出任中东和平与经济合作中心主席。州长查理·克里斯特于2009年11月4日确定，初选在2010年2月2日举行，正式选举在4月13日举行；正式选举原定4月6日，后为避开逾越节而改期。民主党人特德·多伊奇以62%的得票率获胜，共和党人爱德华·林奇获得35%的选票。

en.s: The 2010 Gainesville, Florida mayoral election took place on April 13, 2010, following a primary on March 16, 2010. Incumbent Mayor Pegeen Hanrahan was term-limited and unable to seek a third consecutive term. City Commissioner Craig Lowe placed first in the primary election, winning 40 percent of the vote. Businessman Don Marsh, a former Republican candidate for County Commission, placed second over businesswoman Monica Leadon Cooper, 29–25 percent, and advanced to the general election.

zh.s: 佛罗里达州盖恩斯维尔于2010年3月16日举行市长初选，4月13日举行正式选举。现任市长佩金·汉拉汉因任期限制，无法争取连续第三届任期。市政委员克雷格·洛在初选中以40%的得票率排名第一。曾作为共和党候选人竞选县议员的商人唐·马什，以29%的得票率超过获得25%选票的女商人莫妮卡·利登·库珀，位居第二，晋级正式选举。

en.s: The fourteenth legislative assembly election was held on 13 April 2011 to elect members from 234 constituencies in the India state of Tamil Nadu. Results were released on 13 May 2011. Vijayakanth's Desiya Murpokku Dravida Kazhagam (DMDK), which had contested the previous elections independently, allied with AIADMK coalition. Marumalarchi Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam boycotted the election following disagreement with Jayalalithaa over seat-sharing.

en.s: Lion Air Flight 904 was a scheduled domestic passenger flight from Husein Sastranegara International Airport in Bandung to Ngurah Rai International Airport in Bali, Indonesia. en.s: South Korea's 20th legislative elections were held on 13 April 2016. All 300 members of the National Assembly were elected, 253 from first-past-the-post constituencies and 47 from proportional party lists. The election was an upset victory for the liberal Minjoo Party of Korea, which defied opinion polling by winning a plurality of seats in the election and defeating the ruling conservative Saenuri Party by one seat. In votes for party lists, however, the Minjoo Party came third, behind the Saenuri Party in first place and the new People's Party in second.

zh.s: 韩国于2016年4月13日举行第20届国会选举，选出全部300名议员。其中253人由单一选区以得票最多者当选的方式产生，47人按政党名单比例代表制产生。自由派的共同民主党出人意料地获胜，结果与民调预测相反：该党赢得最多席位，以一席之差超过执政的保守派新国家党。但在政党名单投票中，共同民主党仅排第三，落后于排名第一的新国家党和排名第二的新成立的国民之党。

en.t: Rory McIlroy wins the Masters Tournament, becoming just the sixth person to complete the Grand Slam in golf
en.s: Rory Daniel McIlroy (born 4 May 1989) is a Northern Irish professional golfer who plays on the PGA Tour and the European Tour. He is a former world number one in the Official World Golf Ranking and has spent over 100 weeks in that position during his career. A six-time major champion, he is the sixth man to complete the modern career grand slam—after Gene Sarazen, Ben Hogan, Gary Player, Jack Nicklaus, and Tiger Woods—and the first European to do so.

zh.t: 罗里·麦克罗伊赢得美国大师赛，成为第六位完成高尔夫全满贯的人
zh.s: 罗里·丹尼尔·麦克罗伊（生于1989年5月4日）是北爱尔兰职业高尔夫球手，参加PGA巡回赛和欧洲巡回赛。他曾登上官方世界高尔夫排名第一位，职业生涯累计位居榜首超过100周。他六次赢得大满贯赛事，是第六位完成现代职业生涯全满贯的男子选手，前五位是吉恩·萨拉森、本·霍根、加里·普莱尔、杰克·尼克劳斯和泰格·伍兹；他也是首位完成这一成就的欧洲人。
